Until we arrive

  • Water pouring out: turn the tap at your water meter clockwise until it stops. Most Inner West meters sit just inside the front boundary.
  • Hot water unit leaking: switch off the power or gas to the unit, then close the cold water valve at the tank.
  • Smell gas: turn the gas off at the meter, open doors and windows, and keep away from switches and flames.

Plumbing services across the Inner West

From a dripping tap in a Newtown terrace to a relined sewer under a Balmain courtyard, one team handles the lot. Every job is quoted at a fixed price once we have seen it, and every job is done by a licensed plumber.

Emergencies

Emergency Plumber

Water through the ceiling at 2am does not wait for business hours, and neither do we. Our emergency plumbers work around the clock across the Inner West, every day of the year. We isolate the problem first to stop the damage, then give you a fixed price for the repair before going any further. No call-out fee applies.

24 hour emergency plumbing

Burst Pipe Repairs

A burst pipe can release hundreds of litres an hour into walls and floors. Turn the water off at the meter, then call us. We find the break, cut out the failed section and replace it with new pipe, pressure test the repair and check the pipework around it so the next weak spot does not catch you out.

Burst pipe repairs

Drains and pipes

Blocked Drains

Slow sinks, gurgling toilets and a smell from the yard gully all point to a blocked drain. We run a CCTV drain camera down the line to see exactly what is in the way, then clear it with a high-pressure hydro jet that cuts through tree roots, grease and wipes. You see the footage, so you know the drain is clear and what shape the pipe is in.

Blocked drain clearing

Blocked Stormwater Drains

When gutters overflow or the courtyard floods in a downpour, the stormwater line is usually packed with leaves, silt or roots. We clear pits, downpipes and underground stormwater pipes with jetting gear and check where the water is meant to discharge. Sorting it before the next storm protects footings, subfloors and the fence line you share with next door.

Stormwater drain cleaning

Pipe Relining

Relining repairs a cracked or root-damaged pipe from the inside, with no trench through your paving, garden or driveway. We clean the pipe, pull a resin-soaked liner into place and cure it to form a new pipe within the old one. It suits the tight yards and shared walls of Inner West terraces, where digging is slow, messy and expensive.

No-dig pipe relining

Leak Detection

A water bill that has jumped, a damp patch that keeps coming back or a meter that ticks over with every tap off means water is escaping somewhere. We pressure test the system and use leak detection equipment to pinpoint the exact spot. That means one small repair in the right place instead of pulling up a whole floor to look.

Hidden leak detection

Hot water and gas

Hot Water Systems

Cold shower this morning? We repair, replace and install gas, electric and heat pump hot water systems, and carry out the tempering valve and anode replacements that keep a good unit running longer. If your system is beyond repair, we size the replacement to your household and the space you have available.

Hot water repairs and installs

Gas Plumber

Gas work in NSW must be done by a licensed gasfitter, and that is exactly who we send. We connect cooktops, ovens and BBQ gas points, check for leaks and make sure the installation is compliant when we finish. If you can smell gas, turn it off at the meter and call us straight away.

Licensed gas fitting

Everyday repairs

Toilet Repairs

A toilet that runs constantly, leaks at the base, blocks or will not flush properly wastes water and patience. We replace worn cistern valves and seals, clear blockages and fix leaking pan connections, often on the first visit. If the suite has had its day, we can fit a new water-efficient one.

Toilet and cistern repairs

Leaking Tap Repairs

That steady drip adds up on the water bill and stains basins and baths. We service and repair mixer taps, traditional washer taps, shower taps and garden taps, replacing washers, cartridges, seats and O-rings as needed. Where a tap is past saving, we fit a new one that suits your existing plumbing.

Leaking tap repairs

Leaking Roof Repairs

Water stains on the ceiling often trace back to roof plumbing, such as rusted gutters, cracked flashing, blocked box gutters or failed downpipe joints. We find where the water is getting in, repair or replace the damaged section and make sure rainwater has a clear path off the roof and into the stormwater system.

Roof leak repairs

Water quality and compliance

Backflow Prevention

Backflow devices stop contaminated water flowing back into the drinking supply, and Sydney Water requires testable devices to be checked every year. We install, test and repair backflow prevention devices for commercial sites, strata buildings and homes with irrigation or fire services, and take care of the test report so your property stays compliant.

Backflow testing and installation

Water Filters

Better tasting water straight from the kitchen tap. We supply and install water filters, plumbed in neatly with an isolation valve so cartridge changes are simple. Tell us what you want to remove, whether that is chlorine taste, sediment or odour, and we will recommend a system to suit your home and your budget.

Water filter installation

Rainwater Tanks

A rainwater tank only earns its keep when it is plumbed in properly. We connect tanks to toilets, laundries and garden taps, and repair leaking fittings and blocked inlets on existing tanks. Slimline tanks suit the narrow side passages found across the Inner West, so even a small block can put rain to work.

Rainwater tank plumbing

Irrigation and Pressure Valves

We also install garden irrigation systems and replace pressure reducing valves, the fitting that protects your taps, appliances and hot water system from high mains pressure. Not sure whether your job is on the list? Tell us what you need and we will give you a straight answer on whether we can help.

Ask about your job

Why Inner West plumbing is different

Most of the Inner West was built between the 1880s and the 1930s. The houses are beautiful, and the plumbing underneath them is often as old as the street. Knowing how these homes were put together saves time on every job.

Terraces, semis and tight access

Victorian terraces and Federation semis share walls, sit hard against the boundary and often have no side passage at all. Getting a drain jetter, a hot water unit or a length of pipe to the back of the house can mean carrying it through the hallway or coming in from the rear lane. We plan access before we start, protect your floors on the way through and bring compact gear that fits a laneway gate.

Terracotta sewer lines and tree roots

Original sewer pipes here are short lengths of terracotta joined with mortar. Those joints crack with age, and roots from street trees and backyard figs push in looking for water. They catch paper and fat until the line blocks again and again. A CCTV drain inspection shows whether a clean out is enough, or whether relining the damaged section will fix it for good.

Ageing galvanised water pipes

Many older homes still run on galvanised steel water pipes. They rust from the inside, which narrows the pipe, drops your water pressure and turns the first run of water brown. Eventually they pinhole and leak inside walls and under floors. We find the failing sections and replace them with modern pipe, so the pressure comes back and the leaks stop.

Heritage streets and strata buildings

Large parts of Balmain, Glebe, Annandale and Haberfield sit in heritage conservation areas, so repairs need to be neat and out of sight. Apartments and converted warehouses add shared pipes, common property and strata approvals. We work with owners, strata managers and tenants, explain who is responsible for which pipe, and supply the reports a committee or agent needs.

Drain backing up?

If the shower pools around your feet, the toilet gurgles when the washing machine drains or the gully in the yard overflows, the main line is blocking. In the Inner West that usually means roots in an old terracotta pipe.

  1. See it. A drain camera goes down first, so we know what the blockage is and where it sits.
  2. Clear it. A hydro jet cuts through roots, grease and built-up waste and flushes the line clean.
  3. Stop it coming back. If the pipe is cracked, we can reline it without digging up the courtyard.

You watch the footage before and after, which makes blocked drain repairs in the Inner West a lot less of a guessing game.

Get my drain cleared

No hot water?

No hot water, water that runs warm then cold, or a puddle under the tank all need a plumber who knows gas, electric and heat pump systems. We check the simple fixes first, like a failed thermostat, a worn element or a pilot light that will not stay lit.

If the unit is finished, we replace it with one sized for your household. Storage systems heat water to at least 60 degrees to control bacteria, and a tempering valve brings it down to a safe 50 degrees at bathroom taps. We set both correctly on every job, and our hot water system repairs and replacements cover gas, electric and heat pump units.

Get my hot water back

Leak you cannot find?

A bill that has jumped, a hissing sound in the wall, a warm patch on the floor or mould that keeps returning are all signs of a hidden leak. Old galvanised pipes and worn joints are the usual suspects in Inner West homes.

We test the system, trace the leak to the exact spot and repair it with as little cutting as possible, then pressure test again to prove it has stopped. Catching it early with professional leak detection costs far less than repairing water damage later.

Find my leak

From first call to clean up

Five steps, the same on every job, whether it is a tap washer or a full sewer reline.

  1. Call

    Ring 1300 096 668 or send the quote form. Tell us what is happening and where, and we give you an arrival time.

  2. Diagnose

    Your plumber finds the cause, not just the symptom, with a drain camera or pressure test where it helps.

  3. Fixed quote

    You get a fixed price for the agreed work before anything starts. No call-out fee and no surprises on the invoice.

  4. Fix

    A licensed plumber completes the repair or installation and tests it properly before calling it done.

  5. Clean up

    We clean the work area, take the rubbish with us and walk you through exactly what was done.

Questions Inner West locals ask

How much does a plumber cost in the Inner West?

It depends on the job, so we price each one individually rather than guess over the phone. There is no call-out fee. Once your plumber has seen the problem you get a fixed price for the agreed work, and nothing starts until you say yes. A tap service costs far less than relining a sewer.

Do you charge a call-out fee?

No. We do not charge a call-out fee anywhere in the Inner West. You pay the fixed price we quote for the work you approve, and you know that figure before we pick up a tool. If you decide not to go ahead, you owe nothing for the visit.

How fast can you get to me?

We take emergency calls 24 hours a day, seven days a week, and urgent jobs such as burst pipes, gas leaks and sewage overflows go to the front of the queue. When you call, we tell you who is coming and give you an arrival time, so you are not left waiting on a vague window.

Are your plumbers licensed?

Yes. All work is carried out under NSW plumbing licence 306733C. You can check any NSW trade licence for free on the Service NSW website. Where the work calls for it, such as gas fitting or new drainage, you receive a certificate of compliance once the job is finished and tested.

Why do drains block so often in the Inner West?

Most Inner West homes drain through terracotta sewer pipes laid up to a century ago. The joints crack with age and tree roots grow in looking for water, then catch paper and grease until the line blocks. Jetting clears the blockage, and relining the damaged section stops the roots coming back.

Can you fix a broken pipe without digging up my yard?

Often, yes. Pipe relining repairs cracked, root-damaged or leaking drains from the inside through an existing access point, so paving, gardens and driveways stay where they are. We inspect the line with a camera first to confirm it suits relining. A fully collapsed pipe can still need a short dig.

Plumbers in every Inner West suburb

We work across the whole Inner West, from the harbourside streets of Balmain, Birchgrove and Rozelle down through Lilyfield, Leichhardt and Annandale to Glebe and Camperdown.

Along the rail line we are regularly in Stanmore, Petersham, Lewisham, Summer Hill, Ashfield and Croydon, and out to Haberfield, Five Dock and Drummoyne.

South of Parramatta Road you will find our vans in Newtown, Enmore, Erskineville, St Peters, Sydenham, Tempe, Marrickville and Dulwich Hill. If your street sits between any of these, we cover it too.
